name: download_xml
title: Downloads a URL into a file

origin.description: Downloads a URL into a file. urllib does the transfer. A curl handle is accepted and unused.
origin.value: the bundled order document via a file URL
origin.example: {src <- xml2_example("order-doc.xml"); dest <- tempfile(); download_xml(paste0("file://", src), dest); paste(readLines(dest), collapse = "\n")}

translation.description: Downloads a URL into a file. urllib does the transfer. A curl handle is accepted and unused.
translation.value: the bundled order document via a file URL
translation.example: import tempfile; src = xml2_example("order-doc.xml"); dest = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False).name; download_xml("file://" + src, dest); open(dest).read().rstrip("\n")
